amplitude: 0.5 times past128 source SD; relative-amplitude only; sources past-standardized
site: last transformer block output before final normalization/head; all tokens including Bolt REG
fit: first half of each dataset, source IDs never overlap evaluation; no future fitting except ID2 supervised target on fit rows
scope: Exploratory effect-size screens, no p-values or model ranking; dependent datasets retained separately

gates.3: natural response error<=.5, oracle patch closure<=.05, transfer improves no-edit>=.1 and geometry random>=.05 in every dataset; all random geometry valid
gates.4: worst fixed transform forecast/response RMS>=.1 in every dataset; classical RMS<1e-5
gates.5: short and irrelevant response losses exceed informative long by>=.1 in every dataset; all prefix step-energy ratios<=2
gates.6: all three heldout SAE recon and delta NMSE<=.25; causal response error<=.1; aligned support overlap<=.5; pairwise decoded forecast disagreement<=.1
